notes: Exact breadboard columns and rows are estimated from the image. The pot sits in the lower half, columns 10-12, row f, with each wire in row h of the same column.
The orange wire appears to end at the top of the pot body in the image. I assumed it connects to the middle (wiper) pin's column, as the text and schematic say.
Outer pins go to GND (black wire) and 5V (red wire). The middle pin goes to A0 (orange wire). The pot is symmetric between GND and VCC, so which outer pin is which does not matter.
The Uno's GND.1 is used for ground. Any Uno GND pin would work.
No LED is used, so no series resistor is needed. The serial output (9600 baud over USB) is software only and is not drawn as a part.
